text: Saudi Aramco completed its USD 2.65 billion purchase of Valvoline Inc.'s global products business, now Valvoline Global Operations, in March 2023.

source.name: Aramco: Aramco completes $2.65bn acquisition of Valvoline Inc’s global products business (‘Valvoline Global Operations’)
source.quote: The Saudi Arabian Oil Company (‘Aramco’) has completed the acquisition of the Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV) global products business (‘Valvoline Global Operations’) for $2.65 billion

additionalSources.name: The National (John Benny): Saudi Aramco completes $2.65bn acquisition of Valvoline's products business
additionalSources.quote: Saudi Aramco has completed its acquisition of US motor oil and lubricant maker Valvoline's global products business for $2.65 billion.
